sections.what_happened: Russia attacked overnight with 4 missiles (1 Kh-31P, 3 Kh-59/69 from occupied Zaporizhzhia/Kherson) and 140 drones (70 jet-powered Shahed-type + Gerbera + Parodiya decoys) launched from Oryol, Kursk, Shatalovo, Millerovo and occupied Crimea. Air defences neutralised 115 targets (3 Kh-59/69 + 112 drones, 56 jet-powered). Impacts recorded at 15 locations, debris fell in 4 more. As of the morning the attack was still ongoing with UAVs in the air. This is the same overnight attack as 1000-03 (6 injured in Zaporizhzhia/Chernihiv; Russian claims of Kharkiv/Khmelnitskiy power-station and Chornomorsk port hits) — the tally is the new quantified element, not a new attack.
sections.what_verified: Tally is single-family primary source (Ukrainian Air Force); the underlying attack is corroborated by Reuters (1000-03: governors/emergency service injury reports + Russian defence ministry claims). The tally itself has no second-family confirmation.
sections.what_disputed: Russian defence ministry's claimed targets (Kharkiv/Khmelnitskiy power stations, Chornomorsk port, Odesa-bound cargo vessel) are unverified by Reuters; Ukrainian interception counts are routinely contested and cannot be independently verified from the statement alone.
sections.why_matters: 140 drones in one night, 115 claimed down — the overnight barrage in one counted tally.
sections.context: Background: FOLLOW-UP to totw-20261026-1000-03 (overnight Russia-Ukraine strikes) -- Ukrainian Air Force tally: 4 missiles + 140 drones launched, 115 neutralised, impacts at 15 locations

totw_analysis: Our read: 140 drones in one night, 115 claimed down — the overnight barrage in one counted tally. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Interception math vs ground truth: 115 claimed neutralised against 15 impact sites and 6 injured — how much of the barrage actually got through?
